narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>The number ten was called, so the children must be a multiple of ten. I say ninety children.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Make groups of ten from ninety children, and there are nine full groups.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Nobody is left over, but someone must be out, so that slip is struck.
removed_beats.on_screen: the slip's bubble shows ninety children and groups of ten; ninety children make nine groups of ten with none left over; the slip's bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>To check, divide your answer by each number that was called.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Seventy two divides by six and by nine exactly.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>But divided by ten, seventy two leaves two over, so the game works.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor; the words multiple of both calls, and not a multiple of the third appear; the check lines 72 / 6 = 12, 72 / 9 = 8 and 72 / 10 leaves 2 appear with ticks

old_misconception.wrong_move: A common slip picks ninety children because ten is called. Ninety divides by ten, so everybody fits a group and nobody is out.
